def VTask.piCongrRight {α : Sort u_1} {β₁ : α → Sort u_9} {β₂ : α → Sort u_10} (F : ∀ a, β₁ a ≃ β₂ a) : ((a : α) → β₁ a) ≃ ((a : α) → β₂ a) where
  toFun := fun f a => (F a).toFun (f a)
  invFun := fun f a => (F a).invFun (f a)
  left_inv := by
    intro f
    funext a
    have h : (F a).toFun ((F a).invFun (f a)) = f a := by
      apply Equiv.apply_symm_apply
    exact h
  right_inv := by
    intro f
    funext a
    have h : (F a).invFun ((F a).toFun (f a)) = f a := by
      apply Equiv.symm_apply_apply
